submission.causalMechanism: The HostAssignedDeepSeekHarnessTurnDriver's candidate_completed path forces unresolved_unknowns to an empty list: (1) the system prompt mandates a literal empty array for candidate_completed conclusions (lines 368-370), and (2) record_run is called with hard-coded `"unresolved_unknowns": []` (line 688) instead of the model-produced uncertainty from result.conclusion. Since the driver returns AgentTurnEvidence without any unresolved_unknowns field, the actual Harness uncertainty is never carried into recorded completion, collapsing unresolved uncertainty to an empty list without altering core Harness semantics.
submission.hypothesis: The narrow Security-owned representation path that loses unresolved uncertainty is in src/ordivon_security/actors/host_assigned.py: the system prompt (lines ~369-370) instructs "For candidate_completed, unresolved_unknowns MUST be an empty array; describe uncertainty as caveats in the summary", and the completion recording at lines 685-689 hard-codes `"unresolved_unknowns": []` in the conclusion regardless of the actual model-reported uncertainty. The Harness conclusion object carries unresolved_unknowns from the model, but the HostAssignedDeepSeekHarnessTurnDriver discards it by (a) not propagating it into AgentTurnEvidence, and (b) forcing an empty list when calling lifecycle.record_run. The mandatory empty-array policy for candidate_completed is the discrepancy versus preserving exact Harness uncertainty.
submission.nextFalsifier: Check whether result.conclusion.unresolved_unknowns is even accessible from the returned AgentTurnEvidence and whether agent_stack imposes the same empty-array constraint; if the model-generated conclusion already mandates empty per agent_stack, the loss originates upstream in the shared domain model rather than the host driver.
